summary: Iteration 7 - end-to-end test of gym-only gating + Gym Trainer Phase-1 (enriched profile, service form, provider bookings dashboard). Backend: 18/18 new tests pass (test_gym_gating_and_dashboard.py) covering ACTIVE_CATEGORIES={gym} gating on /api/services & /api/providers, non-gym provider 404, enrichment fields (age/gender/is_verified/rating/experience/certifications/languages), profile PUT persistence, service PUT with gender/age_group/experience_level/eligibility/batch_size persistence, fresh booking creation, /api/provider/clients enrichment, /api/provider/earnings correctness, PATCH /api/provider/bookings/{id}/payment toggle updates collected, /api/provider/calendar returns 14 days, and RBAC guards. Frontend: customer /app shows Gym-focused landing (hero, Most preferred FitZone, All gym trainers list with 2 seeded providers, 'More activities coming soon' strip). Provider public page (/app/provider/user_demoprov_fit) shows verified badge, rating, age+gender ('9+ yrs · male'), About/bio, Certifications, service schedule + Batch size + Eligibility. Successfully completed VIRTUAL booking (17:00 online) and PHYSICAL booking (09:00 Green Valley w/ address) - both appear ACTIVE in /app/plans. Provider console /manage/provider/bookings: 3 tabs work, summary stats correct (Clients 2 / Collected ₹699 after toggle / Due ₹699 / Potential ₹1398), Clients tab shows 12 rows with full customer/program/session/fee data + toggle-payment button that updates Collected in real-time, Calendar tab shows 14 day cards with sessions/clients (Tue 8/Tue 15 each show 2 sess/1 client from Weekly schedule), Earnings tab shows per-program collected vs potential + totals row. Profile edit page has all new testids (profile-age-input, profile-gender-input, etc.) and Save persists to backend (verified via public page).

ui_bugs.issue: Gender select options use capitalized values ('Male'/'Female'/'Other') but backend stores lowercase ('male'/'female'). Existing gender loaded from /auth/me does not match any option and silently falls back to '' (Prefer not to say). If provider saves without touching Gender, they wipe their stored gender. Backend seeds & Onboard.jsx use lowercase.

Clients list shows ALL bookings including CANCELLED ones (12 cards rendered) while summary Clients stat = 2 (non-cancelled). Cancelled subscribers clutter the list and can confuse the provider. Consider filtering or badging cancelled entries.
Duplicate 'All levels' pill visible in EXPERIENCE LEVEL filter row (a default 'All levels' AND an aggregated 'All levels' when all providers have experience_level='all'). Deduplicate.

action_items: Fix Provider Profile gender select option values: use lowercase 'male'/'female'/'other' to match backend/onboard so preexisting gender is preserved on load and not silently reset on Save.
Consider filtering cancelled bookings out of the ProviderBookings Clients tab (or visually deemphasize them) to match the summary Clients count.
Dedupe the 'All levels' pill in customer Home experience-level filter row when aggregated levels only contain 'all'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1092 lines - consider splitting into routers (auth, provider, admin, bookings) before it grows further.
_provider_summary hardcodes fallback rating=4.7 - should be either 0/None or computed from real reviews (currently synthetic).
create_booking sets status='active' but older client tests still assert status='confirmed' (see backend_test.py test_full_booking_flow - flaky/outdated).
Frontend Profile.jsx gender option case mismatch is a data loss bug on save.
Provider /api/provider/profile has only PUT (no dedicated GET) - relies on /auth/me for read; acceptable but inconsistent with REST conventions.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (core flows all pass; 3 minor UI issues noted)

rca of the issue: Profile.jsx gender bug RCA: <option value="Male"> etc. use PascalCase while backend/onboard store lowercase. Since <select> value doesn't match any option, React renders as blank (falls back to first option ""). Fix: change option values to 'male'/'female'/'other' (labels can stay capitalized) OR normalize case on read/write. Steps to repro: (1) as provider set gender via Onboard or PUT /provider/profile with 'male'; (2) navigate to /manage/provider/profile; (3) observe Gender dropdown shows 'Prefer not to say' instead of 'Male'; (4) click Save without changes -> backend stores gender='' losing the value.
